title: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: Our Salvation & China's Desolation

sense.text: We’re going to cover some prophecy today, but don’t think I forgot that we need to change; prophecy means nothing without our changing. “Thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth”: when it says thy counsels, it’s referring to God’s prophecies, his judgments, his testimonies. The Bible is the only true book on the planet.

precepts.why: God’s counsels of faithfulness and truth. “Remember the former things of old”: Isaiah 25:1 says thy counsels of old. “Declaring the end from the beginning”: in God’s counsels he declares the end of times from the beginning of times, “and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure”.

“For of a truth against thy holy child Jesus, whom thou hast anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together, For to do whatsoever thy hand and thy counsel determined before to be done.” Thy counsel is the Bible. It was already prophesied what Herod, Pontius Pilate, the Gentiles and the people of Israel would do to Christ; you can read about that in Psalms the second chapter.

This is for you brothers and sisters that like to read many other books outside of the Holy Bible. “Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read”: read means study; that’s why we gave you four chapters a day, not too tedious. People ask how you know the Bible’s a true book: start with Deuteronomy 28, the curse of Israel, summed up in slavery, oppression and loss of identity. To gainsay it you have to prove that slavery never happened. “None shall want her mate”: you cannot mate the word of God with any other book about God, like the Quran, the Gilgamesh epic or the Egyptian Book of the Dead. “For my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.” “And his hand hath divided it unto them by line”: which prophet would have more lines to write, like Jeremiah, Isaiah, Ezekiel, the three big ones, and which would have less, like Obadiah, Joel, Malachi, Hosea. “From generation to generation shall they dwell therein”: in the land.
When it says no one of these shall fail, this is what it means. “There hath not failed one word of all his good promise”. Nothing fails; if the Lord said it, it shall surely come to pass.

sense.text: “For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.” It’s talking about the destruction of Babylon.
“The city of the terrible nations shall fear thee”: the city of the terrible nations shall fear the Most High.

precepts.why: “And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons”: a dwelling place for lizards and snakes and serpents, “an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.”

“And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.” Sodom and Gomorrah were overthrown with fire and brimstone. That’s not how ancient Babylon fell; ancient Babylon fell to the Persians and Medes. So this is a different Babylon: Babylon the great, which for you Christians is not Iraq, it’s the United States of America. “It shall never be inhabited”: that’s the proof it’s not talking about Iraq. Do people live in Iraq? Yeah.
“Put them in fear, O Lord: that the nations may know themselves to be but men.”

“Who shall not fear thee, O Lord, and glorify thy name? for thou only art holy: for all nations shall come and worship before thee”. That’s going to be done through force; they’re going to get the almighty beat down for them to come before the Lord in worship.

sense.text: “For thou hast been a strength to the poor”. You got people of other nations saying, well, that’s me because I ain’t got no money; it ain’t talking about that. The poor are the poor in spirit of Israel. Nicodemus, who was wealthy, a Pharisee, was one of those poor Israelites that came to Christ by night; Joseph of Arimathea was rich but poor in spirit. Oprah Winfrey, Tyler Perry: they’re all poor in spirit. Loss of identity, an oppressed nation, slavery: that’s what it’s talking about. “A strength to the needy in his distress”: Christians like to throw all nations in there, but it’s talking about the Israelites coming out of all nations.
“Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers”. “The branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low”: all their generation shall be brought low.

precepts.why: Who is that poor the Lord should be a strength to? “That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.” Zion is another name for Israel.

Who is this needy? “When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the Lord will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.” The water is the word of God, like Ephesians 5:26, the washing of water by the word.

What does it mean, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat? “And the Lord will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion”: where all the twelve tribes of Israel are, “and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night”, which protects us from the cold and the heat. “And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.” That’s explaining Isaiah 25.

What does it mean, the noise of strangers? “I will break his yoke from off thy neck, and will burst thy bonds, and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him”. Right now the strange nations serve themselves on us; they reap all the benefits we’re supposed to have. They’ve got their stores opened up in all our communities; they take the money from us and build their communities. Strangers are not going to inherit the goodness of the kingdom of heaven; the Most High is going to smash these strange nations.

“So shall ye know that I am the Lord your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain”: he’s dwelling in Zion, not in all these other nations. “Then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more”: pass through means take it over. They ain’t taking over nothing no more, never again.

sense.text: “A feast of wines on the lees”: lees is the dregs, the sediment of wine that settles at the bottom of the vessel if it is not disturbed; the idiom refers to something at ease. It’s talking about fermented wine; we’re going to have fermented wine, not grape juice, “well refined”. “Make unto all people a feast”: don’t forget the thought; he already said he’s going to bring down the strangers, and they shall not pass through the land. All people is Israel coming out from amongst all people. Many scriptures have a double meaning; Isaiah 34 also talks about the Lord having a sacrifice in the land.

precepts.why: A Christian will look for any verse to include the white man. How do I know? I used to be one. “And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other”. That’s what Christians don’t want to read: the Israelites would be scattered amongst all people.

“To recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria”: Israelites coming from Assyria, which is modern-day Turkey and that area; Egypt, lower Egypt; Pathros, upper Egypt; Cush is Ethiopia; Elam is Iran and India; Shinar is Iraq, that’s why you look up Afro-Iraqis and Afro-Iranians and they look like you and me; Hamath is Syria; the islands of the sea, for example Cape Verde and places like Hawaii. “And shall assemble the outcasts of Israel”: in case you get simple, it gets more specific. “And gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth”, because all 12 tribes were scattered.

“This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many”: the many is the Israelites that believe. “I will drink no more of the fruit of the vine, until that day that I drink it new in the kingdom of God.” Christ said when we get in the kingdom we’re going to have a party; that’s when I’m going to drink this wine.

“For the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife hath made herself ready.” We are the bride of the Lamb, all 12 tribes that repent. “For the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.” “Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb.”

Christ is saying when you make a dinner or a supper, don’t invite rich people who can pay it back to you. “Call the poor, the maimed, the lame, the blind”. “Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God”: I don’t know about y’all, but I want to be there. “And they all with one consent began to make excuse”: wicked Israelites that made excuses why they couldn’t repent and follow the Lord. That first group was symbolic of the religious leaders, the scribes, the Pharisees, the Sadducees. “The poor, and the maimed, and the halt, and the blind”: that’s you and me. “Go out into the highways and hedges”: that’s why they went to the northern kingdom of Israel in Acts 13:46; there’s still room, get the rest of them Israelites scattered abroad. “None of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper”: those scribes, Sadducees and Pharisees will not be allowed to enter in.

sense.text: “And he will destroy in this mountain”: the only thing that can break the spell of witchcraft is the word of God, and this kingdom is filled with witchcraft, whether you call it science or whatever; Christianity is a spell on people. “The face of the covering cast over all people”: a covering of lies, cast over everybody on the planet Earth, “and the vail that is spread over all nations.”

precepts.why: “The burden of Babylon”: the United States of America, the head kingdom. “Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain”: lift ye up the Bible upon the high mountain. Babylon is called the high mountain because this is the greatest government currently on the planet Earth. Everybody wants to come here; ain’t nobody trying to go to Russia.

What is this covering? “For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people”. Like on your check you’ll see your gross and your net: all nations got the net, but the Israelites got the gross darkness, the full mental destruction. “But the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.”

“The earth is given into the hand of the wicked”: the wicked runs this earth. “He covereth the faces of the judges thereof”. The first judge is the heavenly Father: in the Sistine Chapel Michelangelo painted the heavenly Father in the image of a white man, Rodrigo Borgia, Pope Alexander the sixth of Rome, and made Adam a white man. The next judge is Christ: in Leonardo da Vinci’s Last Supper they got Christ in the center dressed in Roman clothing, which is really Cesare Borgia, the son of Pope Alexander the sixth. The next judges are the twelve, and they got two women in the apostles’ seats, Lucrezia Borgia beside him; none of the 12 apostles were women. “If not, where, and who is he?” Who is the wicked? The white man has done all this in the earth.

“Thou art the anointed cherub that covereth”: there’s a spirit that works with the white man; his job is to cover the truth, hide the truth in the earth. “And I have set thee so”: God made it so you can’t change it. I don’t care how many black men want to marry the white women and how many black women want to marry the white man; you can’t change what God has anointed. “Till iniquity was found in thee”: all of this in Ezekiel 28 goes back to the garden of Eden.

“And he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life”: to keep the way of the truth. These cherubims, these angelic spirits, their job was to block the way of truth.

“If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted?” If you obey my commandments won’t you be accepted? “And if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him”: Satan, you’re going to be his father if he disobeys me; Satan will be the father of Cain. This is where the sons of the wicked came from.

“And Cain went out from the presence of the Lord, and dwelt in the land of Nod, on the east of Eden.” What was on the east of Eden? The cherubims to keep the way of truth from mankind. Cain went and dwelt with those spirits.

“That old serpent”: that serpent from Genesis, “called the Devil, and Satan”; he has many names, him and his children. “Which deceiveth the whole world”: that’s the covering cast over the whole world. You think it’s a spirit alone going around deceiving everybody; it’s more than that. That spiritual demon Satan has children on the earth who do his bidding. The internet is a form of those cherubs blocking: for every one video you got with the truth you got a thousand more with nothing but lie after lie, and it gets promoted. TV is putting thoughts of deception in your head: oh, everybody’s the people of God, God loves everybody.

You didn’t know Cain was the child of Satan? Those of you that follow Cain, who became Esau after the flood, you too are the sons and daughters of Satan. “In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God”: whoever don’t want to keep the commandments is not of God. “Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother.”

Still dealing with that covering over the whole earth. “For we wrestle not against flesh and blood”: this is not a physical fight. Whoever sits in the seat of the president of the United States, his job is to fulfill the plans of the elite. Whoever sits in the seat of the World Health Organization, if Fauci’s ever removed, whoever takes that seat is going to fulfill the plans of the global elitists. “Against spiritual wickedness in high places”: there’s a governmental system set up throughout this earth, beginning here in America and the EU, and there are spirits that control them. One president dies or gets removed, the next comes in and fulfills the plan of Satan.

sense.text: “He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord God will wipe away tears from off all faces”. We cry now at the oppression we suffer and the inhumane treatment of our people from sun up to sun down; he said he’s going to wipe away all tears from our eyes. “And the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth”: the rebuke of his people is Deuteronomy 28:15-68, the curses of slavery, oppression and loss of identity. He’s going to remove that from all of us.

precepts.why: “Then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.”

“And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away”: the former things of this world we currently live in.

In case you’re confused about who it’s talking about: “Names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel”. That’s who all tears are going to be wiped away from.

sense.text: “Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us”: not man, he will save us. When we see that sign of the Son of man in heaven we’re going to say this is the day we’ve been waiting for. “We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.” A lot of times we want the Lord to come now. If you had any wisdom you would know it’s good the Lord don’t come yet; probably three fourths of us listening ain’t really ready yet.

precepts.why: “Blessed be the Lord God of Israel”: he’s not the Lord God of all nations on earth, “for he hath visited and redeemed his people, And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David”: the horn of salvation is Christ, prophesied from the book of Genesis on up. “That we should be saved from our enemies”: that’s what Isaiah was talking about. Notice it’s plural, enemies; it’s not one guy. Shut up with your foolishness about one antichrist. “And from the hand of all that hate us”: these are your antichrists.

“Little children”: that’s talking about the Israelites. “And as ye have heard that antichrist shall come”: we’ve been hearing that for a long time. “Even now are there many antichrists”, with an s, plural. So stop looking for one dude.

“And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven”. Christ is coming back in military formation, as birds flying, one in the front leading all the rest. That’s where the United States military gets that formation for their fighter jets; they got it from the Bible, because that’s how Christ is going to roll. “And then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn”: we’re going to cry because we’re going to know this is what we’ve been waiting for all our lives. “And they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other”: that’s music to my ears. That verse also proves the people in Israel today are not the people; the elect of God are scattered worldwide, 12 tribes worldwide.
What is the sign of the Son of man? “As birds flying, so will the Lord of hosts defend Jerusalem”.

We are scattered. “When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered, and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen, then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob.”

“He shall call to the heavens from above”: he’s going to give the angels a command, “and to the earth”: his servants upon the earth, you and me, “that he may judge his people.” “Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.” All nations didn’t make a covenant with God by sacrifice, only the 12 tribes of Israel. We ain’t out trying to gather all races on earth; our job is to gather the 12 tribes of Israel. Sorry Miss Laura, sorry Karen, sorry Ken, to hell with you.
We have waited for him: “In your patience possess ye your souls.”

“Necessary patience in seeking the Lord is better than he that leadeth his life without a guide.” It’s necessary that we all have patience in seeking the Lord. Our job is to guide you in this truth; we can’t force you to keep the commandments. Some of you listen, some of you don’t, and some of you have horrible marriages because you have not taken counsel.

sense.text:
“But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.” I had to find a way to bring change into this class; this is my segue right here. Sin is very deceitful. Some of us get hardened through the deceitfulness of sin; we love sin, and we harden because we say God ain’t gonna do nothing to me.

This happened in Guyana this week: a married brother’s unrepentant daughter introduced him to a woman from her job who wanted a relationship. Y’all keep playing with your rebellious kids and entertaining them. She left them alone in the home and they tongue kissed, and he did not confess it until he developed an outbreak on his mouth, lips, tongue and throat. The infection kept him from swallowing and eating solid food, and the brother died in the hospital. We met the brother when we was in Guyana. You can’t make this stuff up; that was quick judgment. So brothers, keep playing, and you sisters too, banging your ex-boyfriends in the world then sneaking up in shalom. I bring these things up to put fear in you; that’s what it’s supposed to do.

“For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end”. “Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation”: don’t harden your hearts like your forefathers did in the wilderness. Those rebellious Israelites did not enter the promised land: “So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.”

precepts.why: What is sin? “Whosoever committeth sin transgresseth also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law.”

God spared David, God will surely spare me? Bro, you might not be David; in fact I know you not David. “Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily”: I commit a sin and nothing happened to me, “therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.” Because we didn’t get judged right away, our heart is fully set in us to do evil.

This is talking about Moses: “Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season”. Whoever said sinning ain’t pleasurable is a liar; sin is very pleasurable. The problem is it’s only temporary, for a season. Once you get post-nut clarity you realize what you got. Now you got monkeypox; was it worth it, bruh? Was it worth it, sis? You got genital warts now, and you come back into Israel talking about I’m working on myself.

sense.text: “For in this mountain shall the hand of the Lord rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him”. In case you don’t know who Moab is, Moab is the Chinese. China will not be the next world superpower; China is going to be destroyed. “Even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill”: the dunghill is a pile of s-h-i-t. You got the Kemetic community and these Moors talking about black people as the Moabites; stop listening to them.

precepts.why: Let’s talk about the Moabites. When Sodom and Gomorrah were destroyed, Lot and his two daughters escaped and hid in a cave. “Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in unto us”: when they saw the destruction of the cities they thought the whole planet was destroyed with fire, but it was only those five cities. “Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.” They got their father Lot mad drunk. “And the firstborn bare a son, and called his name Moab: the same is the father of the Moabites unto this day.” When you have incest, one of the traits generally is what’s called mongoloidism, the wide flat face; the terminology derives from the people of eastern Asia, named after Mongolia. “And called his name Ben–ammi: the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day.” Ammon is the Japanese. The scholars write that proving Japan to be the children of Ammon carries with it the claim that the Chinese are the children of Moab, and that the Koreans are closely related to the Japanese, so South Korea and North Korea are Ammon.

Another book quotes it as ‘we have heard the pride of China, he is exceeding proud, his loftiness and his arrogancy and his pride and the haughtiness of his heart’. The scholars know who China is and who the Japanese are; it’s only black folks, especially those in Christianity, who don’t have a clue. That’s why it says gross darkness the people. “For was not Israel a derision unto thee? was he found among thieves? for since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy”: they rejoiced when we fell. “O ye that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock”: going into bunkers in the mountains. “We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud)”. “His lies shall not so effect it”: Moab is a lying nation.

“Him that offereth in the high places, and him that burneth incense to his gods.” This goes with their religion; one of the main religions out there is Buddhism. In China they have customs to light incense to their gods and to their ancestors. This is what the Bible is talking about.

“For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped”: they have customs where they bald their head; they call them monks, and Wu-Tang brought a lot of black people back to that. “For I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, saith the Lord.” The Lord said he’s going to break Moab down.

“And these from the land of Sinim.” The Bible dictionary says the land is clearly far off, in the south or the east, and many scholars have favored identification with China. So there’s a remnant of our people in Sinim, which is China, because our people were made slaves in China. That history is not discussed in schools. The Black Holocaust shows the Chinese had trade with East Africa, and the fleet of Admiral Zheng He returned in 1419 with African ambassadors who knew the Chinese emperors kept thousands of African slaves; dwarfs, pygmies and black slaves from the east coast of Africa were prized human cargo, and ‘the extent of the China slave trade is difficult to determine’. Since the Tang dynasty Arab traders brought African slaves to China, called Kunlun, and Zhangzi after Zanzibar, treated as chattel, made to carry heavy goods, repair ships and work the docks, called devil slaves and wild men, and thought never fully human. There are no records of Chinese owners questioning the morality of enslavement; they keep that secret. Y’all want to know why in the hood they don’t like putting money in your hand? They slide it to you on the table because they don’t want to touch you.

“And thou, Asia, that art partaker of the hope of Babylon”: Asia consists of China, Japan, South Korea and North Korea, and Asia has been partaking with Babylon the great, which is the United States of America. “And hast decked thy daughters in whoredom”: the daughters are their corporations, their companies, and the whoredom is business transactions. “Thou hast followed her that is hated in all her works and inventions”: America has been dishonest in gain. “I will send plagues upon thee; widowhood, poverty, famine, sword, and pestilence”: sword is war and pestilence is disease. Look at the Wuhan lab: COVID escaped out of the Wuhan lab, and they published research on monkeypox strains in 2021, and now in 2022 monkeypox is in America, Europe and Asia. And the famine: Shanghai, China’s largest city, 26 million residents in full lockdown and running out of food, 45 cities and 370 million people in lockdown. We think this cannot happen here; it’ll affect a certain amount of cities one month and the next group of cities the next.

“If thou hadst not always slain my chosen”: you read this and go, when did China ever do this? That’s why we had to do the research. China hides records. “And saying over their dead, when thou wast drunken, Set forth the beauty of thy countenance?” When they killed us they mocked us, because we were the greatest people on earth. Two years ago we played a video of the Asians blaming the Africans over there for the COVID thing. “Therefore shalt thou receive recompence”: recompense means payback. “Like as thou hast done unto my chosen, saith the Lord, even so shall God do unto thee”.

“Make ye him drunken: for he magnified himself against the Lord: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.” So don’t feel bad for them. “For since thou spakest of him, thou skippedst for joy”: they danced for joy when they had us as slaves.

“Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.” The eagle is America; the seal of America is the bald eagle. “Kerioth is taken”: one of their cities, “and the strong holds are surprised”: their military. “The mighty men’s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs”: they’re going to be frightened to death. America has a bomb they used in Afghanistan named MOAB, the mother of all bombs, the largest air-dropped conventional bomb. Y’all keep feeling bad for these damn Chinese with their wigs and weaves, you sisters; they hate your black guts. A Chinese museum exhibit compared us with animals. In Jamaica and Liberia Chinese men marry black women to get access to own the land, then leave them on the side of the road with babies.

“Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon thee, O inhabitant of Moab”: don’t feel bad for China; they’re going to get what’s coming to them because of what they did to us. “But a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon”: that’s Jordan, “and shall devour the corner of Moab”. “Woe be unto thee, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perisheth”: destruction to you, China. “For thy sons are taken captives”: prisoners of war. “Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days”. “Thus far is the judgment of Moab”: that’s the judgment of China.

“I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh”: that was a witch; he wanted to see the Lord, but not nigh, because he’s not an Israelite. “There shall come a Star out of Jacob”: that’s Christ, “and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab”: shall smite the corners of China.

sense.text: “And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.” This is talking about China.

“Salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks”: because nations like China and America are going to be destroyed, and we’re going to be in our land singing praises to the Lord. “Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.”

“Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.” Some of you brothers and sisters have mental problems. A sister was on the floor flopping around like a fish; the doctor said ain’t a damn thing wrong with her, and the psychiatrist said ain’t a damn thing wrong with her. If you want peace in your mind, your spirit and your soul, keep your mind stayed on the Lord; meditate in these scriptures.
“For in the Lord Jehovah is everlasting strength”. Before you online start typing it’s not Jehovah: we know the name, so shut the hell up.

“For he bringeth down them that dwell on high”: like the white man, like China, like the Arabs. “The lofty city, he layeth it low”: he’s going to bring these nations down. “The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy”: the Lord is going to let us taste this victory too.

precepts.why: Who is the righteous nation? “The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee”: that’s going to be China and the other nations that are left. “And all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.” They’re going to acknowledge who we are on that day.
“Thy people also shall be all righteous”. We ain’t got to worry about an evil ignorant negro in that day; the rebellious men, sisters and kids amongst us will be gone.

“Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.” If you’re around anybody that says you ain’t got to keep the commandments, run for your life; get the hell away from that man or that woman.
He’s going to let us get a little piece of the action. “And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel”. The party ain’t over.
“For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish”: like China. “Yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.”
